mapper.select: SELECT branch_id AS branchId, branch_name AS branchName FROM branch WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY branch_name, branch_id
SELECT branch_id AS branchId, branch_name AS branchName, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, use_yn AS useYn FROM branch WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY branch_name, branch_id
mapper.insert: insert into branch (company_id, branch_name, address, detail_address) values (#{companyId}, #{branchName}, #{address}, #{detailAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE branch SET branch_name = #{branchName}, address = #{address}, detail_address = #{detailAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND branch_id = #{branchId}
